content: Pascua nishca israel jista chara sucta (6) punzha pishicpimi Jesus rira Betania llactama, chibi pai causachishca Lazaro causaushca llactama.
Chi huasibi Jesusta yapa llaquishcamanda shuc micunata ranaura. Martaga micunata caraura, randi Lazaroga Jesushuan pariu mesaibi tiyarisha micuura.

Chasnaibi Maria apamura shuc chaupi litro tuputa nardo nishca yapa balic asnarina yacuta, caihuan Jesuspa chaquita armachisha paihua acchallahuanda chaquichira. Chasna racpi chi huasi intiru gustu asnac tucura.
Chasna tucucpi Jesus japishca runapuramanda paita huasha japichingarauc Judas Iscariotega Maria rashcata ricusha nira,
Imahuata cai asnarina yacuta mana randichinauraya ashca cullquihuan pugrigunata yanapangahuaca. Caiga ña shuc huata intiruta tarabasha ganashca tupu cullqui balinmi.

Judas casna rimasha mana pugrigunata llaquishcamandachu nira, randi pai shuhua ashami chasnaga nira. Pai cullqui bultsata apasha puric ashami runaguna yanapashun nisha cushca cullquita japisha shuhuagara.
Jesus randi paita nira, Saqui ama chasna rimaichu. Mariaga cai gustu asnarina yacutaga huacaichiura ñuca huañusha pambarina punzharaicu.
Pugrigunataga tucui urasmi canguna charinguichi, randi ñucataga mana unaitachu charihuangaraunguichi nira.
Lazarota huanchinatas yuyarinaun
Ashca israel runaguna Jesus Betaniaibi aushcata yachasha chima rinaura, mana Jesusllata ricungahua, randi Jesus causachishca Lazarotas ricushun nisha rinaura.
Lazarota causachicpi ashca israel runaguna Jesusta quirinaura, israel pagrigunatas saquisha paiguna Jesusta catic tucunaura. Chasna tucucpi chi israel pagri amuguna Lazarotahuas huanchishun ninaura.
Jesus Jerusalenbi yaicushcamanda
Ashca runagunami rishca anaura Jerusalenma pascua jistaraicu. Cayandi punzha yachanaura Jesus Jerusalenma shamusha pactamungarauta.
Chiraicumi runagunaga paita mandac amutashina rasha pangayuc ramagunata pitisha Jesusta tupagringahua rinaura casna caparisha,

content.text: Dios cachashca shamuc ashami balichishca achun

content: Jesus ña shuc malta burrota tupasha jahuai tiyarira Diospa shimibi quillcashca tiyaccuintallata:

content.text: Sion nishca Jerusalen llactai causaccuna ama manzhaichichu.
shuc malta burro jahuai tiyarisha shamuun, nishca.

content: Pundallaga Jesus japishca runagunaga mana intindinaurachu caigunata ricushahuas. Randi Yaya Dios jahuapachama Jesusta apasha sumagyachishcahuashami yuyarinaura tucui cai Jesus pasashcagunaga paimanda casna quillcashca tiyac ashcataga.
Lazarota pambashcamanda Jesus cayasha causachishcai auc runaguna cuintasha puriunaura tucui paiguna ricushcata.
Chiraicumi ashca runagunaga Jesus chi pihuas mana raushcata jatun rashcamanda cuintashcata uyasha paita ñambii tupangahuaca Jerusalenmanda llucshinaura.
Randi fariseogunaga paigunapura cuintanacunaura, Ñáa ricunguichichu, tucui runagunami paihuan rinaun, casnaga mana imatahuas ranata ushangachu raunchi ninaura.
Shuc griego runaguna Jesusta mascanaun
Chi jista uraspi Diosta alabangahua Jerusalen llactama ashca runaguna rinaura. Chi muntunmanda maicangunaga mana-israel griegoguna manaura.
Cai runagunaga Felipema caillayasha ruganaura pai Galilea partimanda Betsaida nishca llactamanda acpi, Jesustami ricunata munanchi nisha.
Chita uyasha Felipe risha Andresta rimara, chihuasha ishcandi Jesusta cuintagrinaura.
Chiguna rugashcata rimacpi Jesus paigunata nira, Ñáuca Runa Tucuc asha huañushcahuasha jahuapachama sumacta raitucuna uras ña pactariunmi.
Sirtupacha cangunata nini, Shuc trigo muyu mana allpa ucui urmasha chingarishaga, mana mirarinzhu, chara pailla tiyan. Randi chingarishaga ashcata miraringami.
Chasnallata maicanbas paihua quiquin causaita cai munduibi mana llaquishaga, quishpisha huiñai causaita charingami. Randi cai mundu causanallata llaquiushaga huiñai chingarishca tucungami.
Maicanbas ñuca mandashcata ranata munac runaga catihuanalla manguichi. Chasnallata ñuca maibi aupihuas chibi paihuas angami. Chasnallata ñuca Yaya paitaga llaquingami nira.
Jesus pai huañungaraushcamanda cuintara

Jesus mas rimasha catira, Ñáuca shungu ucuibi yapa ashca llaquirishcata sintini. Chasna acpihuas imatata nisha. Cai llaquirinamanda quishpichihuai Yaya nishachu rimasha. Mana, mana chasna rimashachu. Chasna tucungahuami shamushcani.
Cunanga can yali ushaiyuc ashcata ricuchipai Yaya. Casna Jesus rimashca ratullai jahuapachamanda shuc shimi uyarira, Ñáucaga ña ñuca ushaita ricuchishcani, chasna ashahuas cutillata ricuchingarauni.
Chibi auc runaguna uyasha ninaura, Rayu man nisha. Randi shuccunaga ninaura, Shuc angelmi Jesusta rimaitucun nisha.
Randi Jesus nira, mana cai rimashca shimiga ñucaraicuchu uyarira, astahuanbas canguna yachangahuami mara.
Mundui ac runagunata taripana punzhaga ña pactarimuunmi. Cunan urasllai cai munduta mandactaga binsishca tucungamiraun.
Randi ñucaga huarcushca asha tucuigunatami ñucahuagmallata apamushami nira.
Casna rimashami imashina pai huañungaraushcata rimaura.

Chita uyasha runaguna cutipanaura, Diospa shimibi quillcashcata uyasha yachanchi Quishpichic Cristoga huiñaitami causanga. Chasna acpi imasata canga Runa Tucucca jahuai huarcuitucusha huañunga nishaga rimangui. Pitan chi Runa Tucucca.

Jesus randi paigunata nira, Punzhayachic bilacuinta cangunahuanga mana unaitachu aungarauni. Chasna acpi canguna chi bila punzhaglla aushcai purichi tutai cangunata ama cungaimanda japingahua. Chi ansa tuta puriushcaishina juchai puric runaga mana yachanzhu maita pai riushcatahuas.

Chi punzhacuinta ñuca cangunahuan caibi augllaita ucta quirihuaichi nira. Chasna quirishami punzhaicuinta cangunas causanguichi nira. Tucui caita rimashcahuasha Jesus paigunamanda llucshisha pacashcacuinta rira.
Israel amuguna Jesusta mana quirinaun
Jesus chasna pihuas mana rashcagunata yapa ushaihuan paiguna ñaupacpi rashca agllaitami paita mana quiric anaura.
Chasna paiguna mana quiricpi Dios rimashcata pasachic runa Isaias nishca quillcashcaga pactarina mara casna nisha:

content.text: Ñáucanchi camachishcata mana pihuas quirinatas munanzhu señor.
Dios yapa ushaita charictaga ricuchishallata pihuas mana ricunata munanzhu nira.

content: Chasna acpimi mana quirinata ushanaura. Chimanda Isaias chasnallata shucpi quillcara:

content.text: Diosmi paiguna ñahuigunata puyuyachira ama ricunauchun nisha,
paiguna yuyaitahuas sinzhiyachira ama intindinauchun nisha.
Chasna rashcani paiguna ñucama ama bulltiamunauachun nisha

content: Isaias chasna Jesusta sumagyachishcata ricushcamandami paimanda chasna cuintara.

Chasna agllaitami ashca israel runaguna Jesusta quirinaura, maicangunaga mandac runaguna manaura. Chasna ashallatami mana pagllai rimac anaura fariseogunata manzhasha, israel tandarina huasigunamanda ama callpachishca tucungahua nisha.
Cai runagunaga Yaya Dios balichishcata munanarandimandami runaguna balichihuachun nisha mas munanaura.
Jesus rimashca shimigunami runagunata taripanga
Chihuasha Jesus sinzhi shimihuan rimara, Maicanbas ñucata quiric runaga mana ñucallatachu quirin, astahuanbas ñucata cachamuc Yayatahuas quirinmi.
Maicanbas ñucata ricuc runaga ñucata cachamuctahuas ña ricunmi.
Ñáucami punzhayachiccuinta ani. Cai munduma shamushcani maicanbas ñucata quiric runaga ama ansaibicuinta saquirichun nisha.

Randi ñuca rimashca shimigunata uyashallata mana cadsuc runataga taripaitucushcai, mana ñucaga taripashachu. Ñáucaga mana taripasha cashtigangahuachu cai pachama shamurani, astahuanbas quishpichingahuami shamurani.
Maicanbas ñucata mana gustasha, ñuca rimashca shimigunatas mana cadsuc runaga ña taripanata charin. Ñáuca rimashca shimigunami puchucai punzhaibiga paita taripasha cashtigangauna.
Ñáucaga mana ñuca quiquin yuyaimandallachu rimani. Ñáucata cachamuc Yayami mandahuara tucui ñuca rimasha yachachichun nisha.
Ñáucaga yachanimi ñuca Yaya mandashca shimigunaga huiñai causaima apan. Chiraicumi ñuca rimashaga ñuca Yaya mandahuashcatatami rimani nira.
